pillars.label: Coordination
pillars.activities: Activate or reinforce area coordination, assign lead partner, escalate resource requests, joint field missions

pillars.label: Surveillance & contact tracing
pillars.activities: Alert investigation, active case finding, contact listing and 21-day follow-up, reporting completeness checks, community-based surveillance

pillars.label: Laboratory
pillars.activities: Sample transport, testing turnaround, mobile lab placement

pillars.label: Case management
pillars.activities: Isolation and treatment capacity, referral pathways, ambulance availability, triage at health facilities

pillars.label: Infection prevention & control
pillars.activities: IPC assessment and support in health facilities, health-worker protection, decontamination

pillars.label: Safe & dignified burial
pillars.activities: SDB team capacity and response time, community alert for deaths

pillars.label: Vaccination
pillars.activities: Ring vaccination of contacts and contacts of contacts, front-line worker vaccination, cold chain

pillars.label: Community engagement / RCCE
pillars.activities: Community feedback, rumour tracking, engagement with leaders, mining and mobile populations

pillars.label: Points of entry & mobility
pillars.activities: Screening at points of control, readiness in receiving areas, cross-border information sharing

pillars.label: Logistics & supplies
pillars.activities: PPE and medical supply pipeline, prepositioning, transport

pillars.label: Security & access
pillars.activities: Access negotiation, movement planning, alternative delivery modalities
